verdict.rationale: Motion is an AI-powered productivity app with built-in AI assistants, so letting users plug in MCP servers as tool sources is a fair question. The evidence pack never mentions MCP client support. The REST API, Zapier integrations and llms.txt are adjacent features, not a way to connect MCP servers whose tools Motion's AI can use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
